name: Podbean
description: Podbean is a podcast hosting, publishing, distribution, monetization, analytics, and private-podcast platform.
agentUseSummary: Connect Podbean through confidential OAuth 2.0 with podcast_read, podcast_update, episode_read, and episode_publish. Agents can read the podcast, episodes, chapters, analytics, and statistics; upload bounded assets; and approval-gate episode publishing, updates, deletion, and chapter replacement. Private-member administration, arbitrary remote fetches, credentials, and unbounded transfers remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: PODBEAN_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Podbean app secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay-owned app secret stored only in Railway.

capabilities.label: Read podcasts, episodes, and analytics
capabilities.description: Read the authorized podcast, episodes, chapters, download and engagement statistics, retention, platforms, sources, and reports.

capabilities.label: Manage episodes and chapters
capabilities.description: Create, update, delete, and chapter one explicit episode.

capabilities.label: Upload episode assets
capabilities.description: Upload one bounded audio, video, image, or transcript asset and return only its Podbean file key.

allowed.label: Read Podbean
allowed.description: Read one pinned podcast, episode, chapter, analytics, or statistics operation.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Podbean episodes
approvalRequired.description: Create, update, delete, or save chapters for one episode; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Upload Podbean media
approvalRequired.description: Authorize and upload one bounded file without exposing the presigned storage credential; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Expose Podbean secrets
blocked.description: Client secrets, access and refresh tokens, presigned URLs, and authorization headers are never exposed.

blocked.label: Make Podbean fetch arbitrary URLs
blocked.description: Remote media, image, and transcript URL fields are blocked to prevent server-side request forgery.

blocked.label: Manage private members
blocked.description: Business-master private-member authority and personally identifying membership operations are not requested or exposed.

blocked.label: Transfer unbounded podcast data
blocked.description: Calls are pinned and bounded; pages cap at 100, responses at 5 MB, and uploads at 25 MB.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; every episode mutation and file upload requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected publishing actions run without Relay per-action approval; fixed origins, bounds, audits, redaction, and provider rules still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives pinned podcast, episode, chapter, analytics, statistics, and bounded upload wrappers.
Hermes receives the same selected capabilities, approval profile, and cloud-held OAuth tokens.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must register a Podbean developer application, provide company/app information and an exact redirect URI, and store the issued app ID and secret. This worker opened no portal and created no account, app, or credential.
providerSetup.nextAction: The acceptance owner should register Relay's Podbean app with https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/podbean/callback, store PODBEAN_CLIENT_ID and PODBEAN_CLIENT_SECRET in the approved Railway environment, then run staging OAuth, podcast binding, representative reads, bounded upload, publish/update/chapter/delete approvals, refresh, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial acceptance.

evidence.supports: Podbean's live generated reference documents confidential OAuth, refresh, four permissions, podcast/episode/chapter operations, presigned upload, analytics/statistics, pagination to 100, and leaky-bucket limits.
The current developer landing page advertises the API and developer app registration.
Podbean's August 2025 guide documents developer registration, app/company information, redirect URI, and issued app ID/secret.
Podbean documents the OAuth, file upload, and episode publishing sequence.
